packageRules.description: Auto-merge patch + pin updates after status checks pass. NOTE: `digest` was deliberately removed from this list — digest-pinned container images are the immutability contract for production-classified stacks (PAR-209), and moving one is an approved rollout with snapshot, canary and rollback, not a bot merge. Digest PRs are still raised; a person merges them.
Auto-merge dev-dependency minor + patch after status checks pass
